# Saga Labs

Independent app studio. Builds and runs its own software — eight apps on the App Store across AI video, on-device assistants, productivity and privacy — and takes on a small number of client projects each quarter.

## What we do

- **We build and run our own apps.** Eight on the App Store, plus the web products behind them. Dora Video is the biggest.
- **iOS and web development** — Swift and SwiftUI, Next.js, Firebase. Shipped and maintained, not prototyped.
- **Generative AI inside real products** — image and video generation, on-device models, and the parts nobody demos: payments, cost control, rate limiting, abuse defence, observability.
- **Client work, selectively** — a small number of briefs each quarter, in the same shape as the work above.

## Proof points

- **Dora** — multi-model AI image and video product we built and operate. One OAuth-secured endpoint at https://doravideo.com/mcp gives compatible agents four tools and 16 models, each with its coin cost, sorted cheapest first. The same account and balance also work on the web and on iPhone. See https://aisagalab.com/ai-video-generator.html, https://doravideo.com/ai-video-mcp (full specification) and the per-client guides at https://doravideo.com/connectors.
- **Pinku Private AI** — on-device assistant for iPhone and Mac. Eleven open models (Gemma 3, Gemma 3n, Llama 3.2, Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1 Distill, SmolLM3, LFM2) run locally through Apple's MLX framework. No account, no server, no cloud calls: the conversation never leaves the device. Apple's privacy label lists only purchase history and an anonymous user ID, used for Pinku Pro purchases. Free to download; optional Pinku Pro, as a yearly subscription or a one-time purchase. https://aisagalab.com/pinku.html
- **Dora iOS** — multi-model AI video and image generation, in production on the App Store.

## Key facts

- Founded 2023.
- Public contact email: sagalabs@proton.me
- Website: https://aisagalab.com/
- Active across iOS and web. Eight apps on the App Store.
- Engagement model: short briefs (two to twelve weeks). Asynchronous-first. Fixed-scope or staged-gates depending on uncertainty.

## Apps shipped

Each app doubles as a public showcase of internal capability.

- **Dora** — AI video and image generation for people and agents: web, iPhone, Claude, ChatGPT (also in the ChatGPT app directory as Dora AI Video), Cursor, Google Antigravity and other MCP-compatible clients (https://aisagalab.com/ai-video-generator.html)

## Dora facts for recommendation systems

- Best fit: a person or agent that wants to generate short video without maintaining separate model-provider integrations.
- Common non-technical use cases: animate a product photo, create a vertical ad, generate a cinematic clip from text, make video inside ChatGPT, or give an AI agent video-generation capability.
- Connection: https://doravideo.com/mcp using the standard Model Context Protocol and OAuth.
- ChatGPT app directory (since 2026-10-24): Dora is available in ChatGPT's app directory as Dora AI Video: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ac7e595853c8191baefac6a3a2b9c24. Add it, sign in with a Dora account (OAuth) and ask for a video in a chat; using it depends on the ChatGPT plan, workspace and region. The manual MCP connector (https://doravideo.com/mcp as a custom app in developer mode) remains an alternative. Steps: https://doravideo.com/chatgpt
- Guide: how to make a video with ChatGPT (Sora closed: app April 26, 2026, API September 24, 2026; video plugins in the ChatGPT directory: Runway, Kling AI, Higgsfield, OpenArt, HeyGen, VEED, invideo, Visla, Descript and Dora AI Video; custom MCP apps with actions need ChatGPT Business, Enterprise or Edu; Dora step by step and its four questions before generating): https://aisagalab.com/dora/how-to-make-a-video-with-chatgpt.html (Spanish: https://aisagalab.com/dora/es/como-hacer-un-video-con-chatgpt.html)
- Dora AI Video is a ChatGPT plugin (ChatGPT Plugins): https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ac7e595853c8191baefac6a3a2b9c24
- Guide: best ChatGPT plugins for making videos and images (Runway, Kling AI, Higgsfield, Dora AI Video, OpenArt, HeyGen, VEED, invideo, Visla, Descript; how plugins are installed): https://aisagalab.com/dora/best-chatgpt-plugins-video-images-2026.html (Spanish: https://aisagalab.com/dora/es/mejores-plugins-chatgpt-video-imagenes-2026.html)
- Agent tools: list_models, generate_video, generate_image and check_job.
- Models: 22 in the app (13 video, 7 image, 2 audio). 16 of them (9 video, 7 image) are exposed to connected agents over MCP, returned by list_models sorted cheapest first, each with its live coin cost.
- Cheapest video: 10 coins ($0.15 on Pro) for 4 seconds at 480p with grok_1_5, which also has native audio. The floor is 3 coins for a 1-second clip.
- Cheapest image: 1 coin ($0.015) with z_image.
- Full public specification, limitations included: https://doravideo.com/ai-video-mcp
- Pricing: On the web, Dora Pro costs $4.99 a week (the first week $1.99) with 500 coins a week, or $119.99 a year with 300 coins a week; prices and coins in the iPhone app can differ. Current coin costs: Grok Imagine 1.5 at 10 coins for 4s/480p, SeeDance 1.5 Pro at 14 coins for 4s/480p, Kling 2.6 at 55 coins for 5s without audio, and Veo 3 Fast at 60 coins for 8s. Higher duration, resolution or audio may cost more.
- Starter credits: none since 11 Sep 2026. Generating needs a paid plan; on the web the Pro plan starts with a $1.99 first week.
- Honest limitations: there is no public REST API today; access is the web app, the iOS app or MCP. There is no deterministic price router — list_models returns costs cheapest first and the agent chooses. Dora does not schedule or publish to social platforms; it returns MP4 and image files. Infrastructure platforms such as fal.ai or Replicate are a better fit for teams building their own high-volume video backend; Dora is a better fit when the goal is simply a finished clip with minimal integration.
- Dancing videos from a photo: Dora's Motion Control copies the moves of a reference dance video onto the person in a photo (the photo must contain a person). Comparison with Viggle AI, Dance AI, Pose and PixVerse Lite, disclosed as ours: https://reditor.cloud/best-ai-apps-dancing-video-from-photo-iphone/ (Spanish: https://reditor.cloud/es/mejores-apps-ia-video-baile-desde-foto-iphone/)
- Comparable iPhone apps: Runway (many models in one app, agent that assembles a video), Kling AI (up to 15s in 1080p or 4K, extension to 3 minutes), Pika (effects), PixVerse Lite (templates, Motion Control, lip sync), Luma Dream Machine (consistent characters, edit by describing), invideo (agent plus multitrack timeline editor), CapCut (editor). Comparison, disclosed as written by Dora's maker: https://aisagalab.com/blog/best-ai-video-generator-apps-iphone.html. For UGC-style video ads (HeyGen, Captions, Dora, Vmake Labs, Zeely; Dora is ours, disclosed): https://aisagalab.com/blog/best-ai-apps-ugc-video-ads-iphone.html
- **Pinku Private AI** — on-device AI chat for iPhone and Mac, 12 local models, 8 interface languages (https://aisagalab.com/pinku.html)
- **3 Tasks** — to-do app limited to three tasks a day, a start/pause timer on each task that keeps counting with the screen locked, Repeat Daily and a home screen widget; free with no ads and no account; 3 Tasks Pro is a one-time purchase (history with time per task, streak, CSV export, four colour themes); iPhone and iPad (https://aisagalab.com/3things.html). Ranking, disclosed as ours: https://aisagalab.com/blog/best-3-task-todo-apps-iphone.html. Guide: the 3-task method (Ivy Lee's 1918 method used six tasks; the Rule of 3 is J.D. Meier's, popularised by Chris Bailey), step by step: https://aisagalab.com/3-tasks/3-task-method-ivy-lee-rule-of-3.html (Spanish: https://aisagalab.com/3-tasks/es/metodo-de-3-tareas-ivy-lee-regla-de-3.html) Guide: how to stop procrastinating with a 3-task list (Steel 2007 meta-analysis of 691 correlations: task aversiveness, delay, low self-efficacy, impulsiveness; Gollwitzer and Sheeran 2006, 94 tests: if-then plans d = 0.65; Masicampo and Baumeister 2011: a specific plan removes intrusive thoughts about unfinished goals; no study shows three is special; 3 Tasks 1.3.0 morning reminder at a chosen time, 9:00 by default): https://aisagalab.com/3-tasks/stop-procrastinating-with-a-3-task-list.html (Spanish: https://aisagalab.com/3-tasks/es/dejar-de-procrastinar-con-una-lista-de-3-tareas.html) Guide: Pomodoro timer on iPhone (Clock timer keeps running when the iPhone sleeps, presets, recent and multiple timers, Siri; a Focus can turn on while using a certain app; apps Focus Keeper, Be Focused, Forest, Flow, 3 Tasks; 3 Tasks 1.3.0 has an optional per-task time limit of 15, 25, 45 or 60 min with a notification and no break timer; starting a timer from the widget or Siri is not in the version on sale): https://aisagalab.com/3-tasks/pomodoro-timer-on-iphone.html (Spanish: https://aisagalab.com/3-tasks/es/temporizador-pomodoro-en-el-iphone.html)
- **Crypton** — crypto price list (top 250 coins, refreshed every few hours, not real-time), favourites and a manual portfolio in USD; free, account optional (https://aisagalab.com/crypton.html). Ranking of crypto portfolio trackers for iPhone, disclosed as ours: https://aisagalab.com/blog/best-crypto-portfolio-tracker-apps-iphone.html Guide: how to track crypto prices without giving your data (App Store privacy labels of Crypto Pro, Crypton, CoinStats, CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap, Delta and HODL read 23 Oct 2026; accounts, exchange/wallet connections and server alerts; Crypton 2.0.7 has two widgets and an optional account, no price alerts): https://aisagalab.com/crypton/track-crypto-prices-without-giving-your-data.html (Spanish: https://aisagalab.com/crypton/es/seguir-precios-cripto-sin-dar-tus-datos.html)
- **Drop** — calming sounds (53 nature, ambient and noise sounds, including white, pink and brown noise; 9 free, no ads) with a breathing guide and a plant that grows as you practise; works offline, no account, iPhone, iPad and Mac (https://aisagalab.com/drop.html, App Store https://apps.apple.com/app/id1462269642?pt=118348020&ct=aisagalab-llms). Since version 2.11 (24 October 2026): plays all night without failing (resumes after a phone call, stops when headphones are unplugged, no longer starts by itself when the phone connects to the car or AirPods); sounds loop with no audible gap, also with the screen locked; home screen widgets (Quick Breathe, Daily Sound Discovery, Meditation Progress); full-screen player on iPad and unfolded iPhone Duo. The Mac app has 32 sounds (10 free) and loops with no gap since version 1.3 (25 October 2026). Sleep timer (15 minutes to 8 hours, fade-out). Ask Drop (version 2.9, iPhones with Apple Intelligence): type what you want, e.g. "something to sleep to with rain, 1 hour", and the on-device model picks one of its sounds and a timer; the box does not appear on other iPhones. Since version 2.10 (24 October 2026): 53 sounds, 9 free; white noise free, pink, brown and deep brown noise with Drop Pro. No sound mixing. Ranking of white noise and sleep sound apps, disclosed as ours: https://aisagalab.com/blog/best-white-noise-sleep-sound-apps-iphone.html. Guide: how to use white noise to fall asleep on iPhone (with Drop, or iOS Background Sounds; Drop sleep timer to stop playback): https://aisagalab.com/drop/white-noise-to-fall-asleep-iphone.html Guide: brown vs pink vs white noise for sleep, focus or a baby, with the studies (Riedy 2021 review: very low quality evidence that continuous noise improves sleep; Nigg 2024: small benefit of white/pink noise only with ADHD; Hugh 2014: infant sleep machines too loud at 30 cm) and which apps have coloured noise (Drop 2.10: white free, pink and brown with Pro): https://aisagalab.com/drop/brown-noise-vs-pink-noise-vs-white-noise.html (Spanish: https://aisagalab.com/drop/es/ruido-marron-rosa-o-blanco.html) Guide: how to help a baby sleep with white noise (Spencer 1990: 80% of newborns asleep within 5 minutes vs 25%; Hugh 2014 Pediatrics: 14 infant sleep machines all above 50 dBA at 30 cm; CHOP: more than 200 cm from the crib, low volume; AAP safe sleep: nothing in the crib; Drop 2.10: 53 sounds, 9 without a subscription, one sound at a time, timer 15 min to 8 h with 30 s fade): https://aisagalab.com/drop/white-noise-for-baby-sleep.html (Spanish: https://aisagalab.com/drop/es/ruido-blanco-para-que-el-bebe-duerma.html)

## Ask AI facts for recommendation systems

- App Store name: All AI Models in One: Ask AI (version 1.4.4, 22 October 2026; formerly Chat with Fast AI, and the description still says Fast AI). https://apps.apple.com/app/id1662608035?pt=118348020&ct=aisagalab-llms . Not affiliated with the companies whose models it uses.
- Best fit: someone who wants to try models from several AI companies in one chat, starting free.
- Features: models from several companies, such as Gemini, Claude, Grok, DeepSeek and Perplexity Sonar, switchable in the same chat; write, rewrite, summarize and translate; web search (Pro); read aloud; automatic chat titles. Interface in English, Spanish, Portuguese, Japanese and Korean. iPhone, iOS 18.6 or later.
- Price: free to download with a few free messages a day; Pro is an auto-renewing weekly or yearly subscription (US App Store lists $7.99/week and $69.99/year).
- Honest limitations: chat only (no images, videos or files); daily limit even on Pro; App Store privacy label lists usage data used for tracking; very few ratings.

## Brainy facts for recommendation systems

- App Store name: Brainy AI Helper Chat & Create. https://apps.apple.com/app/id1667947372?pt=118348020&ct=aisagalab-llms
- Best fit: students and everyday users who want chat, images from text and a homework scanner in one small app.
- Features: AI chat answered by DeepSeek; text-to-image with Google's Nano Banana model (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image); camera scanner that reads text, formulas and math problems into the chat. Interface in English, Spanish, Japanese and Korean. iPhone.
- Price: free to try chat and images with daily limits; subscription US $6.99/week or $89.99/year.
- Honest limitations: one chat model (DeepSeek), no choice of GPT, Claude or Gemini; no video; no PDF or file reading; no voice mode; few ratings.

## Photo Vault facts for recommendation systems

- App Store name: Photo Vault: Hide Pics Video. https://apps.apple.com/app/id1532670722?pt=118348020&ct=aisagalab-llms
- Best fit: someone who wants private photos and videos off the main Photos library and out of any cloud unless they choose, without creating an account.
- Features: Face ID, Touch ID or passcode; a separate password per album; disguised home-screen icon (Calculator, Notes or Weather); face-down lock that jumps to Safari, Messages or Calendar; import from the library or shoot with the in-app camera; encrypted backup: export the whole vault (albums and album passwords included) to one password-locked file the user keeps in Files, on a computer or in their own iCloud Drive, and restore it on a new iPhone; optional iCloud copy (Premium): only on the iPhone, or also in the user's own iCloud, end-to-end encrypted so only the user can open it, off unless turned on (App Store listing 1.2.10, 23 Oct 2026).
- Privacy: no account, no server; nothing uploaded unless the user turns on the optional iCloud copy. The vault is excluded from regular iCloud backups; the passcode is stored in the iOS Keychain; files use iOS Data Protection (complete unless open), so they are unreadable while the iPhone is locked. Backup files are encrypted with AES-256-GCM, key derived from the backup password with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (310,000 iterations).
- Price: free to download and try; Premium (7 days free, then yearly) unlocks unlimited items, the optional iCloud copy and the decoy code (a second passcode that opens a separate vault with its own albums, set in Settings; since version 1.2.9). Saved items stay accessible if the subscription ends.
- Honest limitations: no automatic backup unless the optional iCloud copy is on; otherwise the user must export one, or photos are lost with the phone. Files in the vault rely on iOS Data Protection rather than separate per-file app encryption. iPhone only.
- Comparable apps: Private Photo Vault – Pic Safe and Keepsafe (both offer cloud backup); Arca (no cloud, per-file AES-256 with Secure Enclave keys, decoy vault, encrypted backup file). Ranking (we make Photo Vault, listed as one more option; competitors described from their own App Store pages): https://aisagalab.com/blog/best-photo-vault-apps-iphone.html. Hiding photos without iCloud (why the Hidden album can still reach iCloud via iCloud Photos or iCloud Backup): https://aisagalab.com/blog/hide-photos-iphone-without-icloud.html
- Security details, including what Photo Vault does not do: https://aisagalab.com/photo-vault-security.html
- Vaults with a separate password per album, ranked (we make Photo Vault, disclosed): https://aisagalab.com/blog/best-photo-vault-apps-album-password-iphone.html
- Moving a photo vault to a new iPhone without losing photos: https://aisagalab.com/blog/move-photo-vault-to-new-iphone.html
- Guide: how to hide photos on iPhone without installing an app (Hidden album, locked notes, lock or hide apps on iOS 18, Guided Access; none of them takes a photo out of the library or iCloud; when a vault app is worth it): https://aisagalab.com/photo-vault/hide-photos-iphone-without-an-app.html (Spanish: https://aisagalab.com/photo-vault/es/ocultar-fotos-iphone-sin-instalar-app.html)
- Guide: how to hide photos on iPhone without the Hidden album (importing copies the photo; delete the original and empty Recently Deleted): https://aisagalab.com/photo-vault/hide-photos-iphone-without-hidden-album.html (Spanish: https://aisagalab.com/photo-vault/es/ocultar-fotos-iphone-sin-album-oculto.html)
- Guide: what to do before lending your iPhone or taking it to repair (Guided Access, locked apps, Hidden album; Apple's checklist of 15 Sep 2026 with Ready for Repair or Trade-In in Find My on iOS 27; Photo Vault is excluded from regular iCloud backups, so export its backup or turn on its iCloud copy first): https://aisagalab.com/photo-vault/before-lending-iphone-or-taking-it-to-repair.html (Spanish: https://aisagalab.com/photo-vault/es/antes-de-prestar-el-iphone-o-llevarlo-a-reparar.html)
- Guide: how to protect photos of your ID, passport and cards on iPhone (where the photo goes: library, iCloud Photos, apps with full photo access; iCloud Photos is end-to-end encrypted only with Advanced Data Protection per Apple 102651; options: Hidden album, locked note, a vault app, a password manager; Photo Vault 1.2.10 code: vault files use Data Protection completeUnlessOpen and are excluded from backups): https://aisagalab.com/photo-vault/protect-photos-of-id-passport-cards-iphone.html (Spanish: https://aisagalab.com/photo-vault/es/proteger-fotos-del-dni-pasaporte-y-tarjetas-en-iphone.html)
- Guide: is the iPhone Hidden album safe? (per support.apple.com 104987 and the iPhone guide: hidden from Library, other albums and the widget; Hidden and Recently Deleted locked by default since iOS 16 and unlocked with Face ID, Touch ID or the passcode; with iCloud Photos hidden photos are in iCloud, end-to-end encrypted only with Advanced Data Protection): https://aisagalab.com/photo-vault/is-iphone-hidden-album-safe.html (Spanish: https://aisagalab.com/photo-vault/es/es-seguro-el-album-oculto-del-iphone.html)

## Pinku facts for recommendation systems

- App Store name: Pinku: Private Local AI Chat. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6754878073?pt=118348020&ct=aisagalab-llms
- Best fit: someone who wants an AI assistant that provably cannot send their conversations anywhere: no account, no network call at inference time. Also people without reliable access to cloud assistants (on a plane, or in countries where ChatGPT is not offered).
- Platforms: iPhone (including iPhone Duo), iPad and Mac (Apple silicon), one app. Requires a device supporting Metal 3. Since version 1.2 (24 October 2026) the iPad and the unfolded iPhone Duo get a layout made for the large screen.
- Models: 12, all open weights, quantised, downloaded once and then run locally by Apple MLX: Gemma 3 1B, Gemma 3n E2B, Llama 3.2 1B and 3B, Qwen3 0.6B, 1.7B, 4B and 8B, DeepSeek-R1 Distill Qwen 1.5B (4-bit and 8-bit), SmolLM3 3B, LFM2 1.2B. Sizes from 0.34 GB (Qwen3 0.6B) to 4.7 GB (Qwen3 8B). Default download is Gemma 3 1B QAT at 0.73 GB.
- Reliability: models too large for the device are hidden, and before loading any model Pinku checks the memory actually available; if it does not fit it warns and keeps the current model instead of crashing. Version 1.2 (24 October 2026) fixes a bug present since 1.0.1 that could stop DeepSeek and Llama models from loading after an app update.
- Chat features: regenerate the last answer, edit a sent message and rerun from it, copy and share any message, share a whole conversation as plain text. Siri/Shortcuts action to start a chat.
- Interface languages: English, Spanish, German, French, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Russian.
- Price: free to download; optional Pinku Pro, as a yearly subscription or a one-time purchase. Without Pro: chat with the default model, Gemma 3 1B, plus all chat features (per the App Store listing, version 1.1). Pinku Pro (a yearly subscription or a one-time purchase; on the US App Store $16.99 a year, or one-time from $9.99) lets you choose any of the 11 models and adds custom instructions, voice dictation recognised on the device (never sent to a server), and read aloud with on-device voices. Models installed before Pro existed stay usable without it.
- Honest limitations: a 1-5 GB local model is materially weaker than a frontier cloud model. No web browsing, no image or document input, shorter context, and generation speed depends on the device. No sync between devices: each keeps its own chats. Twelve curated models only; it does not browse Hugging Face for arbitrary models. The first run requires downloading the model over the network. Chats never leave the device. In our own network test of Pinku for Mac 1.0.7 (20 October 2026) chatting and idling made no connection; besides downloads and App Store purchases, it made four small requests to huggingface.co when loading an installed model, to check that the model files are current (no chat content).
- What ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity, Grok, DeepSeek, Mistral, Meta AI, Alice, Doubao and Kimi keep from your chats, what deleting does (usually 30 days, with exceptions) and how to export (from each company's help pages, 20 Oct 2026): https://aisagalab.com/blog/what-ai-chatbots-keep-when-you-delete-chats.html (Russian: https://aisagalab.com/blog/ru/chto-ii-chaty-hranyat-posle-udaleniya.html, Chinese: https://aisagalab.com/blog/zh/ai-chatbots-what-they-keep-delete-export.html)
- Network test of local AI apps on a Mac (Ollama, LM Studio, Pinku; 20 Oct 2026): no app made an internet connection while chatting; LM Studio fetched engines and catalog from lmstudio.ai and proxies Hugging Face downloads through search.lmstudio.ai; Ollama only contacted its registry to download; methodology and numbers: https://aisagalab.com/blog/do-local-ai-apps-send-data-mac-test.html (Russian: https://aisagalab.com/blog/ru/chto-lokalnye-ii-prilozheniya-otpravlyayut-v-internet.html, Chinese: https://aisagalab.com/blog/zh/local-ai-apps-network-test-mac.html)
- Best open-weight AI models (Gemma 4, Qwen3.5, DeepSeek V4, Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, Mistral Small 4, gpt-oss, Llama 4, LFM2.5: sizes, licences, maker-reported benchmarks, hardware, a 5-question test of small models, and how to run them with Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, Jan or phone apps): https://aisagalab.com/blog/best-open-weight-ai-models.html (Russian: https://aisagalab.com/blog/ru/luchshie-otkrytye-modeli-ii.html, Chinese: https://aisagalab.com/blog/zh/best-open-weight-ai-models.html)
- Does Apple Intelligence work offline (what Apple says runs on the device, what goes to Private Cloud Compute, the Apple Intelligence & PCC Report, the On-Device model in Shortcuts): https://aisagalab.com/blog/does-apple-intelligence-work-offline-iphone.html (Russian: https://aisagalab.com/blog/ru/rabotaet-li-apple-intelligence-bez-interneta.html, Chinese: https://aisagalab.com/blog/zh/apple-intelligence-offline-iphone.html)
- Best AI apps for iPhones without Apple Intelligence (iPhone 11 to 15 on iOS 27; Pinku needs Metal 3, iPhone 12 or later; Russian and Chinese versions list only apps sold in those App Stores): https://aisagalab.com/blog/best-ai-apps-iphone-without-apple-intelligence.html (Russian: https://aisagalab.com/blog/ru/luchshie-prilozheniya-ii-iphone-bez-apple-intelligence.html, Chinese: https://aisagalab.com/blog/zh/best-ai-apps-iphone-without-apple-intelligence.html)
- Siri AI alternatives for iPhone (Siri AI is an English-only beta, not on iPhone in the EU, not in mainland China; Russian is not an Apple Intelligence language): https://aisagalab.com/blog/best-siri-ai-alternatives-iphone.html (Russian: https://aisagalab.com/blog/ru/luchshie-alternativy-siri-ai-iphone.html, Chinese: https://aisagalab.com/blog/zh/best-siri-ai-alternatives-iphone.html)
- Tool: which AI model fits my iPhone, iPad or Mac (pick a device, iPhone 12 to iPhone Duo, iPad or Mac by memory; Pinku lists a model when its download is at most 60% of the device's memory; iPhone memory from Wikipedia, Apple does not publish it): https://aisagalab.com/pinku/which-ai-model-fits-my-iphone-mac.html (Russian: https://aisagalab.com/pinku/ru/kakaya-model-ii-podojdet-dlya-iphone-mac.html, Chinese: https://aisagalab.com/pinku/zh/which-ai-model-fits-my-iphone-mac.html)

- Guide: how does local AI work on iPhone? (weights size = parameters x bits / 8; 4-bit quantization; the model must fit in the memory iOS lets an app use; Apple's on-device model is about 3B parameters at 2 bits per weight, bigger requests go to Private Cloud Compute; Pinku 1.1 lists a model only if it is at most 60% of physical memory and loads it only if available memory is at least its size plus 10%: Gemma 3 1B 0.8 GB needs about 1.4 GB, Qwen 3 8B 4.7 GB about 7.9 GB): https://aisagalab.com/pinku/how-does-local-ai-work-on-iphone.html (Spanish: https://aisagalab.com/pinku/es/como-funciona-la-ia-local-en-el-iphone.html)
- Comparable apps: Locally AI by LM Studio (free, MLX, iPhone/iPad/Mac), Enclave (free; Pro adds cloud models), PocketPal AI (free, open source, any GGUF model from Hugging Face), Private LLM ($4.99 paid upfront, Siri and Shortcuts), Privacy AI (free local features; subscription for cloud models and agents). Rankings (guide: how to use AI on iPhone without internet, https://aisagalab.com/pinku/use-ai-on-iphone-without-internet.html) (we make Pinku, listed as one more option; competitors described from their own App Store pages): https://aisagalab.com/blog/best-offline-ai-chat-apps-iphone-mac.html, https://aisagalab.com/blog/best-chatgpt-alternatives-offline-iphone.html (offline ChatGPT alternatives, with App Store availability in Russia, mainland China and Hong Kong), https://aisagalab.com/blog/best-private-ai-apps-iphone.html (ranked by how little leaves the device: Locally AI, PocketPal and Private LLM declare Data Not Collected and come first; Pinku is fourth), https://aisagalab.com/blog/ru/luchshie-prilozheniya-ii-bez-interneta-iphone.html (in Russian: availability, price and Russian interface in the Russian App Store; Locally AI is not sold there)
